studio.name: Dewlane Skin Studio
studio.parking: Free parking in the building garage, level 1.
studio.hours: Tuesday to Saturday 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday.
studio.estheticians: Camila Reyes (acne and sensitive skin), Jordan Blake (anti-aging and peels).

services.name: Free Skin Consultation
services.description: A skin analysis with an esthetician and a personal treatment and home-care plan. Best when the guest is unsure or has several concerns.
services.prep: Come with a clean face if you can, and bring a list of the products you use now.

services.name: Signature Hydrating Facial
services.description: Deep cleanse, gentle exfoliation, hyaluronic mask and facial massage for plump, glowing skin.
services.prep: No special preparation. Skip at-home exfoliants the day before.

services.name: Clarifying Acne Facial
services.description: Purifying cleanse, extractions, salicylic treatment and a calming clay mask for clearer skin.
services.prep: Avoid retinol and strong acids for 2 days before.
services.not_suitable: Not while taking isotretinoin (Accutane) or within 6 months of stopping it.

services.name: Calming Barrier Facial
services.description: Fragrance-free facial with soothing botanicals and a cooling mask that repairs the skin barrier.
services.prep: Pause any new active products for 3 days before.

services.name: Brightening Glow Peel
services.description: Professional lactic and mandelic acid peel that evens tone and brightens.
services.prep: Stop retinol and exfoliating acids 3 days before. No waxing or sunburn on the face that week.
services.not_suitable: Not during pregnancy, on sunburned or broken skin, or within 6 months of isotretinoin.

services.name: Collagen Microneedling
services.description: Collagen induction treatment for smoother texture, softer lines and acne scars. Best as a series of 3.
services.prep: Stop retinol 5 days before. Avoid blood thinners like aspirin for 3 days unless prescribed. Arrive without makeup.
services.not_suitable: Not during pregnancy, with active breakouts or cold sores, or within 6 months of isotretinoin.

services.name: Dermaplaning Glow
services.description: Gentle blade exfoliation that removes dead skin and peach fuzz for an instant smooth glow.

services.name: LED Light Therapy (add-on)
services.description: Blue or red LED light added to any facial: blue calms breakouts, red supports collagen.

policies: New guests: arrive 10 minutes early to fill in a short skin questionnaire.
Cancellations and changes: please give 24 hours' notice. Late cancellations may be charged 50% of the treatment.
Payment: card or cash at the visit. Packages of 3 microneedling sessions save 15%.
Aftercare for peels and microneedling: no makeup for 24 hours, SPF 30 or higher every day, no retinol for 5 days.
